svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A

g.data-description: HIG Management Port LED table - left lamp Off (no power), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); right lamp Off, Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity). The two lamps do not share a vocabulary, so states are per element. At this placement's rotate: 180 (preserving the pre-sweep common/rj45-port@4 render, which the mgmt-stack provenance ties to the photographed green corner lamps) the component-local left window (led-a) renders on screen-right, so led-a carries the physical-right/amber pair and led-b the physical-left/green pair, keeping the same physical lamp assignment
g.title: mgmt-oob

g.data-description: HIG SYS row - Off (no power), Solid Green (host CPU/BMC boot complete), Solid Amber (power is up but host CPU boot failed)
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG FAN row - Off (fans not initialized), Solid Green (all fans work normal), Blinking Amber (fan fail: one or more fans need service)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG PS0 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU0 working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU0 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-ps0

g.data-description: HIG PS1 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU1 working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU1 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: HIG ID row - Off (no power), Blinking Blue (beacon feature is enabled on the switch)
g.title: led-id
